description.value: Naas Foods is an Indigenous-owned specialty shop in Tofino selling premium wild kelp seasonings, seafood packages, and custom sport fish processing services from their Campbell Street storefront. They source kelp from Ahousaht waters and support the T'aaq-wiihak indigenous fishery, making this one of the most distinctly local food stops on the west coast of Vancouver Island. Touring cyclists can pick up ready-to-prepare seafood packages or browse kelp-based seasonings to take on the road.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Naas Foods is an active Indigenous-owned seafood and kelp products retail shop with a physical Tofino storefront, offering 'Free local pickup' and selling seafood packages (crab buckets, prawn buckets, seafood boil kits) — there is no website evidence of the cafe-style food service (coffee, bagels, sandwiches, breakfast) implied by the OSM cuisine tags. Phone number matches between OSM and website; the address has a minor discrepancy ('630 Campbell Street' in OSM vs '630a Campbell St' on the website contact page). No cyclist-specific amenities (bike parking, washrooms, Wi-Fi, etc.) are mentioned anywhere on the site.
concerns: OSM tags this as amenity=cafe with cuisine including coffee_shop, bagel, sandwich, breakfast — but the website shows no evidence of cafe-style food service; the business is a specialty seafood and kelp products retail store. The OSM cafe tag appears incorrect.
Address discrepancy: OSM lists '630 Campbell Street' but the website contact page lists '630a Campbell St' — the unit suffix 'a' is present on the website but absent in OSM.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operating Indigenous-owned food shop in Tofino with an active e-commerce site and physical storefront — a useful and distinctive provisioning stop for touring cyclists.
